input_freshness.meaning: Fresh driver/controller, capability child and separate recognition child over immutable saved RGBA/PNG and request/resource snapshots

limitations: One pair per case is descriptive development evidence, not qualified performance acceptance.
Frozen effective beb064f/dd320 producer roles are separate from the authored Cargo Git pin and final release source.
Whole operation, driver invocation, child stages and parent delivery each retain their own boundaries and clocks.
EntrySettled precedes session close/owner drop; later Terminal, reap, stream join and ControllerSettled are also required.
Direct recognition-child RSS is one point after trial owner release, not OS peak, same-owner growth, final-owner residual or leak proof.
Reconciled lifetime CPU and effective resolution remain unavailable; post-workload thread metadata is not a PID-role census or invariance.
The old hit numerical/incomplete control fence remains unchanged and applies to qualification; current diagnostic smoke safety rules alone permit these fresh outputs.
Private original receipts are retained locally, not included or claimed as receiver-verified bytes.
